title: Mont-Blanc Marathon — official homepage
claims: The 2027 event runs from 24 to 27 June 2027 in Chamonix.
The Mont Blanc Marathon is organised by the Club des Sports de Chamonix, a non-profit organisation founded in 1905.
Under the name 'Marathon du Mont-Blanc', eight races open to participants aged 7 and over are held on the trails around Chamonix in the Mont-Blanc massif.
Registration for the 2027 Mont Blanc Marathon is scheduled to open in November 2026 in several phases; the detailed schedule and procedures were still to be published.

The Sunday 27 June 2027 programme gives the women's elite 42 km start at 06:45, the men's elite 42 km start at 07:15 followed by non-elite runners, first 42 km finishers at 10:45 and the 42 km awards at 17:00.
